segments.name: Precision diagnostics
segments.description: Commercial-stage diagnostics company offering non-invasive urologic tests, mainly for prostate cancer, to physicians and patients.
segments.evidence: The Company monitors the profitability of the group as a whole given revenues are generated from clinical laboratory service testing and accordingly does not distinguish different business segments.

revenueModel.text: Medicare and commercial payors reimburse the company for the diagnostic tests it performs for patients.
revenueModel.evidence: Adoption of our tests has been supported by nationwide reimbursement for Medicare patients, as well as by consistent expansion of coverage by commercial payors.
